epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce mean time to recovery by 50%
requirements: R1: System backup must be triggered by an administrator

slices.title: Implement system backup trigger
slices.jtbd: When implementing the backup mechanism for this epic, I want to create a secure snapshot of the database and uploaded files, so that system safety is ensured
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an admin user
When they trigger a backup
Then the backend creates and securely stores a snapshot of the database and uploaded files
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce backup script execution time to under 5 mins

epics.sixSigmaMetric: increase search result relevance score by 20%
requirements: R1: Search results include indexed materials from LMS platforms

slices.title: Include LMS metadata in unified search
slices.jtbd: When implementing search inclusion for this epic, I want to query LmsMetadata alongside KbDocuments, so that knowledge retrieval fragmentation is reduced
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a search query
When the user executes a search
Then the backend searches both local KbDocuments and synchronized LmsMetadata, returning a unified set of results
